Class TrafficController

java.lang.Object
traffic.sim.TrafficController
public class TrafficController extends Object
Phase 2 "brain" for managed parking. It replaces the simple Phase 1 first-come parking helper (which only found the nearest free spot) with a smarter coordinator that, each tick while Phase 2 is on:
  1. assignParking() — proactively reserves the nearest reachable free spot for every seeker, and redirects seekers early when the curb near them is full (so they never stop and block lane 0);
  2. enforceWaitLimit() — any car that has still waited too long is redirected (and optionally camera-fined);
  3. policePatrol() — an optional, more visible version that warns cars that have waited even briefly.

It also works for Phase 1 callers through bestReachableSpot(Car, Lane), which finds a spot without reserving it — that lets the single Simulation class run both phases from the same code.

    • releaseReservationFor

      public void releaseReservationFor(Car c)
      Called when a car leaves the world outside the normal parking path (collision despawn or end-of-street exit). Without this the reservation map would keep a reference to the removed car and its spot would stay stuck "reserved" forever. Safe to call on any car.

    • forgetReservation

      public void forgetReservation(Car c)
      Called after a successful park. The reservation is consumed: the spot goes straight from "reserved by c" to "occupied by c", so we drop the bookkeeping without calling ParkingSpot.release().
